static_traits.name: Li Ming轩
static_traits.family_status: 家庭支持Good：Mother为牙医，有两位姐妹。
static_traits.social_status: 与同事的互动因对自身skill的悲观看法受到影响；家庭支持度高。
static_traits.medical_history: without重要躯体疾病，without既往类似心理问题及治疗史。
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑连贯、配合度高，能自我Reflection并具备一定洞察。

basic_info.main_problem: 我倾向于negate自己烘焙skill中的积极面，只关注错误和失败。这种消极思维模式在上周一次三层蛋糕的烘焙失误后出现。自那以后，我对自己的烘焙能力过于苛刻，坚信自己再也without法做出完美的蛋糕；这些想法在每次尝试烘焙时都会出现，导致Self-doubt与挫败，并影响工作与与同事的互动。
basic_info.core_demands: I have noticed that my negative thinking patterns are affecting my passion for baking and my overall well-being, so I am seeking counseling to gain support and guidance.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough / I will fail

special_situations.event: 上周为一份特殊订单制作三层蛋糕时失败（层次not齐、外观not佳）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果一次作品失败，就证明我永远做not好复杂蛋糕，也not适合做烘焙
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly remakes the same cake to prove oneself, demanding 'must be perfect' by absolutist standards
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远做not好三层蛋糕/我not行

special_situations.event: 每次开始新的烘焙任务前，想起三层蛋糕的失败
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我再尝试，结果还会一样糟
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Procrastinates or hesitates to start, or over-monitors details after starting, causing tension
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这次也会搞砸/肯定失败

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有做出复杂的完美蛋糕才算成功，简单产品not算成绩
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 贬低或忽视正向经验，not做记录与巩固
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这not算成功，饼干太简单了

special_situations.event: 在工作中检查成品质量、回想此前失败
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能每次都做对，就说明I cannot do anything well
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 只盯着瑕疵与错误，忽略整体完成度与优点
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我在厨房里什么都做not对

core_conflict.wish: 渴望通过作品被认可、被看见为胜任且有价值
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与被negate，担心因not完美而失去价值感
defense_goal: Uses self-criticism and high standards to control risk and avoid failing again and feeling shame
通过negate积极经验来维持“谨慎”，避免放松警惕

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的/可能失败的烘焙者
object_relations.object_representation: 苛刻的评判者（挑剔他人或内在批评者）

object_relations.self_representation: 需要被支持和鼓励的年轻人
object_relations.object_representation: 支持性的照顾者（Mother与姐妹）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing or recalling the three-layer cake failure, or facing complex baking tasks
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 一次失败就意味着“完全not行”，若再尝试会再次出丑
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use绝对化词语（如“永远”“完全”）自责，放大错误，降低自我评价与语气能量。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当他人或咨询师邀请其关注近期成功或积极证据时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 承认成功等于忽视问题、会放松警惕
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gives seemingly reasonable explanations to belittle success (e.g. 'the task was too simple'), weakening the positive meaning.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当需要评价作品品质或做出成败判断时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: not是完美就是失败，have not中间地带
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use非黑即白的评语，坚持“必须/只能”的表达，拒绝承认部分成功。

manifestations: 对热爱的烘焙乐趣下降，难以像过去那样享受
被“必须做出完美蛋糕”的内在规则束缚
害怕再次失败而犹豫尝试

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 在会谈与工作中频繁自责，use“永远/not行”等绝对化表达
过度在意可能的错误，谨小慎微以至于表现受限

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 将“必须做出完美蛋糕才算成功”内化为绝对标准
negate饼干等简单任务的成功，将其视为“not算数”

exception_events.target_problem: 在回想三层蛋糕失败后开始烘焙时，来访者通常会Anticipation失败、Decreased attention并出现Self-doubt，从而影响作品质量。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 上周有一次烤制饼干的经历“做得挺好”，与往常not同的是当次成品满意、体验相对积极。
exception_events.reason: 线索：任务难度较低（饼干相对not如三层蛋糕复杂），由此降低紧张和失败Anticipation，更易集中注意力。

positive_force: 家庭支持Good（Mother与两位姐妹可提供帮助与指导）
具备自我Reflection能力，能识do not“自我实现预言”的模式
Willing to try recording positive experiences and cognitive restructuring (agrees to write a log of successes/challenges in parallel)
有坚持性与行动力（多次尝试重做蛋糕）
存在可被看见的成功经验（如饼干烘焙成功）
negative_force: 消极认知模式显著（negate积极、心理过滤、过度概括、预测not yet来、非黑即白）
完美主义/全或without标准Reinforcement失败恐惧
过度自我批评，易将一次失败等同为全面without能
失败Anticipation导致紧张与Decreased attention，进一步干扰表现
倾向贬低正向证据，削弱Self-efficacy

target_behavior.behavior: 在烘焙任务中出现强烈失败Anticipation与Self-doubt，注意力涣散。
antecedent: 开始新的烘焙任务前回想三层蛋糕失败
面对难度较高或复杂的烘焙要求（如三层蛋糕）
target_behavior.core_reason: 对失败的灾难化与“全或without”标准、过度概括导致对自身能力的稳定性负面推断。
target_behavior.function: Psychologically avoiding potential failure and shame, trying to gain a sense of control through self-defense.
target_behavior.consequence: 表现受损、错误增加、Decreased job satisfaction，并影响与同事的互动与自尊。

target_behavior.behavior: negate积极结果（将成功经验视为“not算数”）。
antecedent: 当出现较顺利的烘焙结果（如饼干成功）
被提醒关注正向证据或小的进步
target_behavior.core_reason: 完美主义标准与心理过滤，认为只有复杂作品且完美without瑕才算成功。
target_behavior.function: 维持与内在负性图式的一致性，避免面对not确定性或放松警惕。
target_behavior.consequence: Self-efficacy受损、Decreased motivation，延续消极情绪与失败Anticipation的循环。
